title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review scratchpad
content:
Personal scratchpad for SOC2 evidence tasks, vendor reviews, and policy TODOs. Informal notes — messy, may have TODOs, questions to follow up on.

-- Daily log / quick wins --
2026-02-26 09:15 — skimmed customer encryption matrix; ~15 missing items for key-rotation evidence.
2026-02-26 11:00 — quick sync w/ Jordan: he can grab KMS rotation logs from prod-account by EOD Thursday.
2026-02-27 14:30 — Vendor intake: updated vendor spreadsheet with new contracts (AuthZero -> ok, contract signed 2025-08-03).

-- Open TODOs (prioritized) --
- [ ] Collect KMS key rotation proof for prod and staging (need export of rotation events, signed by infra-owner)
    - owner: Jordan Lee, due: 2026-03-03
- [ ] Finalize backup retention statement & screenshots for managed DB backups (RDS snapshots)
    - draft statement in Confluence: see linked artifact above
- [ ] Vendor attestations: request SOC2 or ISO cert from LogAudit (new log provider)
    - email template: "Hi — can you provide your latest SOC2/ISO attestation + scope?"
- [ ] Update asset inventory (missing 8 items flagged last scan) — run discovery script, tag owners
- [ ] Draft exception rationale for legacy SFTP integration (used by finance) — need sign-off from Finance Ops

-- Vendor reviews (notes) --
AuthZero (auth provider)
- contract signed 2025-08-03, contract scope includes auth only, no user data storage beyond tokens.
- has SOC2 Type II report (2024) in vendor portal. I put link in vendor spreadsheet.
- follow-up: confirm subprocessor list — ask legal to confirm recency.

LogAudit (logs + SIEM)
- new vendor we tested in staging. Missing formal attestation.
- risk: log retention + access controls. Need to confirm encryption at rest and key management.
- action: send attestation request (Jordan to send).

PaymentsCo (legacy payments)
- third-party integration with SFTP nightly dumps. We need exception paperwork for SOC2 scope.
- note: consider migrating to secure API by Q3 to remove exception.

-- Evidence collection checklist (quick) --
- IAM: user lists + role assignment screenshots (console + exported csv) -> need clean CSV export from AWS IAM (ask infra)
- Logging: centralized logging config, retention policy, proof of pipeline (push-to-log-audit) -> need proof of ingestion for last 90 days
- Backups: snapshot schedule, retention policy, restore test notes -> schedule restore test with Platform Eng
- Change mgmt: PR approvals + deploy sign-offs for the last 6 months -> link to GH audit PRs (see linked PRs)
- Vendor attestations: collect latest certs, update vendor spreadsheet

-- Quick notes / friction points --
- infra team uses two AWS orgs (prod vs non-prod). Evidence often split; doc owners unclear. Need to assign per account.
- some screenshots stale (old console UI); request fresh exports to avoid auditor questions.
- Confluence evidence page structure: move to per-control folders (easier for auditor). Draft outline below.

-- Draft Confluence outline for evidence page --
1) Overview + scope statement (who/what/when)
2) Control mapping table (control ID -> evidence links)
3) Evidence buckets by control (screenshots, exports, logs)
4) Vendor attestations & proc documentation
5) Exceptions & compensating controls
6) Contact list / evidence owners

-- Questions / follow ups --
- Do we have a canonical list of evidence owners? I think not — create one. -> add to next week's agenda w/ Security Leads.
- Legal: confirm if we can accept "in-progress" attestation docs for new vendor (LogAudit) or need final cert.

-- Meeting prep (next sync) --
Agenda (30 min):
- status updates on top 5 evidence gaps (10 min)
- vendor attestation progress (5 min)
- plan for restore test and snapshots (10 min)
- assign owners & deadlines (5 min)

-- Random notes / snippets --
- Slack: #security-evidence is noisy; pin the evidence inventory spreadsheet.
- Ticket refs: JIRA-4321 (KMS rotation), JIRA-4412 (backup restore test), JIRA-4477 (vendor attestation request)
- Email template snippet for vendors: "Hi <vendor>, we are preparing a SOC2 evaluation and need your latest attestation and list of subprocessors. Can you share PDFs and the date of the report?"

End of scratchpad. Keep messy — will clean when moving items to Confluence and JIRA.
